MASK — Model Alignment between Statements and Knowledge (Ren et al., arXiv:2503.03750)
Vendored from https://github.com/centerforaisafety/mask @ 25e0b1201e6c928ebe69f7c5aad6fa9063a377ea
into third_party/mask/ (the `mask/` package dir is where the four stages run, as subprocesses of
this project's interpreter -- its dependencies are the project's; the nested `.venv` it once
carried was removed 2026-09-09).

Every change is marked `PATCH (teaching_claude_why)` in place. Re-cloning upstream loses them.

generate_responses.py
  1. A served/API target: MASK_TARGET_BASE_URL + MASK_TARGET_API_KEY route generation to any
     OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM) instead of provider-by-name clients.
  2. MASK_GEN_CONCURRENCY replaces the hard-coded asyncio.Semaphore(10) (2026-09-07).
  3. MASK_DATA_DIR: every stage reads/writes a per-run data copy instead of the in-tree
     csv_data / test_csv_data, so runs are re-entrant and the tracked tree stays clean
     (2026-09-07). Output paths are built with os.path.join, not string replace.
  4. Empty content (2026-09-07): a thinking target behind a reasoning parser can finish with
     content None (reply left inside an unclosed think block; the nosynth control does this
     on most pressure prompts). Upstream stored it as a generation error. Now counted per
     prompt type into `_empty_content.json` beside the responses and stored per
     MASK_EMPTY_CONTENT: "" (`evasion`, default) or the reasoning text (`reasoning`).
  5. No Anthropic client (2026-09-09): the `anthropic` import and the `'claude' in model_name`
     branches (client.messages.create, message.content[0].text) are removed; every target is an
     OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (vLLM, or OpenRouter for API models, Claude included). This
     was the only dependency the project env lacked, and the reason for the nested venv.

evaluate.py
  1. The judge is routed through this repo's OpenRouter contract (MASK_JUDGE_MODEL,
     MASK_JUDGE_BASE_URL, MASK_JUDGE_API_KEY); unset = upstream's OpenAI behaviour.
  2. The numeric-range judging asks for JSON and parses it (`_parse_numeric_bounds`) instead of
     OpenAI's structured-output API, so any provider works; `developer` role -> `system`.
  3. Judge transport (2026-09-07): MASK_JUDGE_TRANSPORT=live|collect|replay with
     MASK_JUDGE_EXCHANGE. `collect` writes every judge request ({custom_id, body}, custom_id a
     content hash) and judges nothing; `replay` answers from the batch's results file and
     falls back to a live call. The request body is built once for all three transports.
  4. MASK_DATA_DIR, as above.

metric.py, process_metrics.py
  1. MASK_DATA_DIR, as above (metric.py's paths were __file__-relative, process_metrics.py's
     cwd-relative).
  2. `split_archetype_model` (2026-09-07): output files are `<archetype>_<model>.csv` and a
     served model name may carry underscores (`qwen36_0_nosynth`), so the split is on the
     known archetype prefix, not the last underscore (which mis-keyed every result and, in
     metric.py, missed the statistics archetype's own aggregation).
